messages:
maya: quick async standup — did a short canary on routing rules, saw a small bump in 429s on /v1/generate in staging (2% over 10m).
maya: what I did: pushed rt/fallback-auth-cache branch to a 3-node canary, added a temporary metric for auth cache misses.
maya: blocker: can't reproduce locally; logs point to auth lookup spikes during cache misses causing the policy evaluator to return 429 in some fast-fail paths.
maya: today: dig into policy evaluator, add fallback route for slow auth lookups, and open a tiny PR for the metric + smoke runner.
juan: can you paste a minimal request that triggered the 429s? I ran a replay against the branch and didn't see failures.
maya: snippet from the logs (redacted headers):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Rw-Client: mobile-android/1.2.3
body: {"prompt":"...","max_tokens":256}
```
sam: saw something similar last week when we tightened per-client token buckets. @maya — can you check rl-config for clients with burst=0 or very low burst?
tomas: I'll run a smoke against the canary branch rt/fallback-auth-cache with the replay tool:
`./tools/replay -i samples/staging-1m.json -t 0.5`
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for branch rt/fallback-auth-cache -> gw-canary-14 (nodes: 3) — https://deploys/redwood/gw-canary-14
maya: tagged the logs with gw-canary-14; search key = gw-canary-14. added metric: gateway.auth.cache.miss_rate (temporary).
anu: FYI I rotated the JWT verifier cache TTL yesterday which could change auth lookup latency profile — worth baselining before we revert anything.
sam: can you open a tiny PR with the metric and a smoke script? I can review today.
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/482 — add cache miss metric + fallback route logic (WIP).
juan: ack — I'll run the replay against gw-canary-14 and post numbers later.
tomas: early numbers from a 10k request run: 429s dropped from ~2% to 0.2% on the canary. quick log excerpt:
`[2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] gw-canary-14 auth_lookup=12ms cache_miss=true route_eval=4ms status=429`
maya: thanks. proposal: add a temporary routing rule: if auth_lookup > 50ms, route to fallback model pool (avoid user-facing 429s). thoughts?
anu: agree — I'll prototype a policy rule this afternoon. ping me if you need test creds.
maya: otherwise no other blockers. pairing with @sam on the PR review at 15:00 PT.
sam: I'll add a quick dashboard graph for gateway.auth.cache.miss_rate by route and a 5m rolling error rate.
deploy-bot: Canary finished: gw-canary-14 -> promoted -> gw-stable-52 (rollout complete, 5m). :rocket:
maya: nice — leaving thread open for replay results and any fallout. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
